data.one_liner: Shared UI widgets, utilities and VM‑service helpers for Flutter DevTools extensions.
data.what_it_does: Provides common DevTools‑styled widgets, global‑variable helpers, lifecycle mixins, and service‑manager APIs. It centralises UI and service logic used across DevTools and its extensions.
use_when: You are building a DevTools plugin or extension and need the same UI components and service helpers as the main DevTools app.
You want consistent styling and utilities (globals, AutoDisposeMixin, service management) across multiple tooling surfaces.
avoid_when: You are developing a regular consumer Flutter app that does not integrate with DevTools.
You need a full‑featured UI kit or theming system beyond DevTools styling.
strengths: Ensures visual and functional consistency with official DevTools.
Reduces duplication of service‑manager and utility code across tooling projects.
Includes ready‑made DevTools‑styled widgets and mixins.
weaknesses: Tailored to DevTools use‑case; may be overkill for general apps.
Adds a dependency on many DevTools‑specific packages.
Limited documentation beyond the README examples.

alternatives.name: devtools_shared
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides core service and utility code without the extra UI components, useful if you only need non‑UI shared logic.
